instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: A finished experiment is reported in an abstract. Why is the past simple used?
questions.explanation: The past simple reports a completed action, which is what an abstract describes.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط يصف فعلاً منتهياً، وهذا ما يصفه المستخلص عادة.

questions.question: Why is 'The auditor is knowing the figure' wrong?
questions.explanation: State verbs such as know describe a condition, not an activity, so they avoid the continuous.
questions.explanation_ar: أفعال الحالة مثل know تصف حالة لا نشاطاً، فتمتنع عن الصيغة المستمرة.

questions.question: In 'Been here two days', what has been left out?
questions.explanation: Informal writing often drops the subject and auxiliary, so it means I have been here two days.
questions.explanation_ar: الكتابة غير الرسمية تحذف الفاعل والفعل المساعد، فالمعنى I have been here two days.

questions.question: Max has been at camp for a while. Why is the present perfect used?
options: it ended before another past act
it will finish in the near future
it happens again and again here
it began in the past and continues
options_en: it ended before another past act
it will finish in the near future
it happens again and again here
it began in the past and continues
questions.explanation: The present perfect links a situation that started in the past to the present moment.
questions.explanation_ar: المضارع التام يربط موقفاً بدأ في الماضي باللحظة الحاضرة.

questions.question: Which sentence is appropriate in academic writing?
options: The results indicate a clear trend.
The results show a cool trend.
The results are kinda very clear.
The results look pretty neat now.
options_en: The results indicate a clear trend.
The results show a cool trend.
The results are kinda very clear.
The results look pretty neat now.
questions.explanation: Academic register prefers formal vocabulary and avoids slang and vague informal wording.
questions.explanation_ar: الأسلوب الأكاديمي يفضل المفردات الرسمية ويتجنب العامية والتعبيرات الغامضة.

questions.question: How is 'a student who is 25 years old' written as a compound?
questions.explanation: A compound adjective before a noun is hyphenated and keeps the singular form of the noun.
questions.explanation_ar: الصفة المركّبة قبل الاسم تُكتب بشرطة ويبقى الاسم مفرداً.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the passive correctly in a report?
questions.explanation: The passive is formed with be plus the past participle, so were tested is correct.
questions.explanation_ar: المبني للمجهول يُبنى من be مع اسم المفعول، فالصحيح were tested.

questions.question: Which tense reports a general truth in an academic text?
questions.explanation: A general truth or a permanent state takes the present simple, not a perfect form.
questions.explanation_ar: الحقيقة العامة أو الحالة الدائمة تأخذ المضارع البسيط، لا صيغة تامة.
